name: UI mockup kit
summary: Illustrated product screens: fields that fill, buttons that press, bubbles that pop, bars that grow, stamps that slam, toggles, tabs and ticks that draw.
qualityBar: Button press hits exactly 0.96 at its lowest point and the label swaps at pressT + 0.1
Bubble pop overshoots 7-13 percent and ends at 1; stamp starts at 2.2, ends at 1, crosses its final size at least 3 times; toggle knob overshoots over 1.05
Tab underline lands exactly on the index in 0.35 s; tick done in 0.25 s; count-up runs 0 to the value
Each of 9 parts draws nothing before its t0 and over 300 lit pixels after (real canvas pixels)
Field fill bar measured at fillW +-8 px; pressed button smaller than resting; stat bar and tick stroke grow progressively; toggle knob moves right
Demo 8 s 1080x1920 silent with two tabs: QC passes, no frozen run over 0.5 s
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (60 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed with 4 warning(s), motion floor 0.00818290134270986).
